thag2.45:1.1: Na ukkhipe no ca parikkhipe pare, na okkhipe pāragataṃ na eraye, na cattavaṇṇaṃ parisāsu byāhare anuddhato sammitabhāṇi subbato. || ||
thag2.45:2.1: susukhumanipuṇatthadassinā matikusalena nivātavuttinā saṃsevitabuddhasīlinā nibbānaṃ na hi tena dullabhan ti. || || Visākho Pañcālīputto thero.
